name: status-pill
title: Status pill
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Status chip. Tone, dot, and label come from props.

files.content:
/** Shared tone names. Host tokens only — no colors. */

export type StatusTone = "neutral" | "accent" | "warning" | "critical" | "info" | "positive"

meta.descriptionEs: Un tono, un punto y una etiqueta que tú escribes.

examples.title: Pastilla de estado
examples.description: Un tono, un punto y una etiqueta que tú escribes.

api.name: tone
api.description: neutral, accent, warning, critical, info, or positive.

api.name: solid / dot / overlay
api.description: Solid fill, a leading dot, or a chip that sits on a cover.

docs: Clean-room, domain-agnostic review workflow. The behavior was observed in an unlicensed operations-dashboard demonstration. No source, product name, sample copy, icons, photos, or assets were copied. Labels come from props or a typed config. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. Inverted surfaces use foreground and background. Highlight uses the host primary. The item ships no theme.
